subjects.name: The Way of the Shadow Wolves

summary: Robert Evans and Shereen Lani Younes read The Way of the Shadow Wolves, a self-published 2018 thriller by actor Steven Seagal and ex-marshal Tom Morrissey that mixes Deep State conspiracy, border fearmongering and anti-Muslim bigotry.

evidence.note: Co-author Tom Morrissey introduced with his marshal and music background
Arpaio's foreword read in full alongside his record as sheriff
Publisher's last post, January 2018, announces the book's release
Preface rant about the Deep State, banking families and a church
Pig-blood knife scene and anti-Muslim content discussed at length
Novel frames border crossings as a media distraction and jihadist threat
Seagal's unfounded Native ancestry claim and appropriation discussed
Seagal's honorary deputization by Arpaio's office explained
Novel set in the Arizona desert south of Phoenix

notes: Covered span set to the book's 2018 publication; Seagal's film career and abuse allegations get only a short intro. Primary theme is a judgment call between conspiracy-theories and entertainment-celebrity. Morrissey's birth year unknown. Approximate because the publication year is inferred from the publisher's post.
